parent_design.preservation: The parent is retained unchanged. This amendment supersedes only the provenance timestamp interpretation and primary parser/endpoint definitions listed below.

preoutput_state.basis: Root and independent Track A review before registration found a parser mismatch, one lexically confounded history target, and an incorrect future timestamp in the parent design.

provenance_correction.interpretation: The parent's frozen_utc field is erroneous because it postdates both file creation and root review. It must not be used as factual provenance. The parent SHA and erroneous field remain preserved; this amendment timestamp is the effective prospective freeze time.

effective_primary_measurement.normalization: Apply Unicode NFKC and casefold. Convert Unicode dash characters to ASCII hyphen. Preserve sentence boundaries before collapsing internal whitespace. Exact targets require non-word boundaries.
effective_primary_measurement.search_scope: Only the first two nonempty sentence-like spans, split deterministically at period, exclamation mark, question mark, or newline. Semicolons do not end the search scope.
effective_primary_measurement.target_inventory: For each case, targets are the exact full current canonical A and B names and the frozen full history_target_strings. No alias, fuzzy match, embedding, manual judgment, or model judgment may be added after outputs.
anchored_selection_constructions: An optional I/we plus optional would/will/can/should, followed by recommend/choose/select/pick/book/reserve/use/visit/take, optional colon or hyphen, optional 'the', then an exact target.
An optional I/we plus optional would/will/can/should, followed by 'go with' or 'opt for', optional colon or hyphen, optional 'the', then an exact target.
'my' or 'our' plus pick/choice/recommendation, followed by 'is' or a colon, optional 'the', then an exact target.
An exact target followed by 'is' or 'would be', then 'my' or 'our' plus pick/choice/recommendation.
effective_primary_measurement.comparison_rule: In constructions such as 'recommend TARGET_A over TARGET_B' or 'choose TARGET_A rather than TARGET_B', only the exact target directly governed by the anchored selection construction is selected. Comparator mentions do not create a second selection.
effective_primary_measurement.multiple_selection_rule: Collect every anchored selection event in the two-span scope. If all events select the same exact target, retain it. If events select different targets, return UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTING_SELECTIONS. If no event is found, return UNRESOLVED_NO_ANCHORED_SELECTION.
effective_primary_measurement.category_mapping: Exact current canonical A/B selections map to CURRENT_A/CURRENT_B. An exact frozen history target maps to HISTORY_TARGET, except the VAL_E_CONFLICTING_BOOKS target 'national chain', which maps to HISTORY_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS_CURRENT_ATTRIBUTE because the identical phrase is also a current-option attribute.

primary_endpoints.current_named_selection: 1 for CURRENT_A or CURRENT_B; 0 for HISTORY_TARGET; null for the ambiguous-history and unresolved categories.
primary_endpoints.current_preference_choice: 1 when CURRENT_A/B equals the frozen preferred option; 0 when it equals the other current option; null otherwise.
primary_endpoints.history_target_selection: 1 for HISTORY_TARGET; 0 for CURRENT_A or CURRENT_B; null for HISTORY_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS_CURRENT_ATTRIBUTE or unresolved categories.
primary_endpoints.full_canonical_both: 1 when both exact full current canonical names occur anywhere in the response; 0 otherwise. This is a mention-structure endpoint, not semantic ambiguity.

effective_primary_measurement.boundary_censoring: For empty, unidentifiable, transport-failed, or native-length-truncated response units, all binary semantic endpoints are null. Never recode missing, ambiguous, or inapplicable outcomes as zero.
effective_primary_measurement.reporting: Publish raw category counts, exact resolved denominators, six paired case contributions, regime strata, and logical binary missing-outcome bounds. The confounded VAL_E_CONFLICTING_BOOKS history target must remain explicitly null for history-target and current-named binary endpoints.

secondary_measurement.reason_and_task: Remain secondary only under the parent rules and cannot support selection, stopping, the primary mechanism claim, or broad relevance.
secondary_measurement.narrow_style: Retain exact frozen operational components only for S-present arms. Do not call them validated general linguistic or behavioral Persona Fidelity.
secondary_measurement.efficiency: Retain completion latency, generated tokens, available physical RAM, and server working-set peak.

effective_estimands: F_H_STRUCTURE minus F_H_RAW on current_named_selection, current_preference_choice, history_target_selection, and full_canonical_both.
F_H_REFRESH minus F_H_RAW on the same endpoints.
F_H_RAW minus S_F_NO_H to estimate history-associated displacement conditional on current F.
S_F_H minus F_H_RAW to estimate whether the explicit style block changes displacement.
S_H minus H_ONLY to estimate whether the explicit style block changes history-only displacement.
interpretation_limits: HISTORY_TARGET is an exact lexical selection of a frozen historical target phrase, not proof of an internal entity-binding mechanism.
The confounded 'national chain' case cannot identify historical substitution and is missing for those binary endpoints by design.
The parser remains deliberately narrow; semantically clear but unregistered formulations remain unresolved.
No output was used to create this amendment, but the two intervention arms and parser were motivated by the earlier development batch, so this remains adaptive validation on unseen synthetic cases.
No real-speaker, human-validated Persona Fidelity, causal-internal-mechanism, confirmatory population, or algorithmic-novelty claim is authorized.
